data.name: Pexet Inc.
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Time is fractured. Pexet Inc. wants you to fix it… or die trying.

Pexet Inc. is a top-down 2D survival horror adventure where time itself becomes your worst enemy. Explore the ruins of a corrupted research facility, shift between past, present, and future, and survive nightmarish experiments gone wrong. Solve puzzles that span timelines, manage scarce resources, and fight (or flee from) horrifying creatures in a world teetering on collapse.

You don’t just play in time you play with it.

Key Features

  • Timeline Shifting
    Jump between the past, present, and future to open new paths, uncover hidden truths, and survive escalating threats.

  • Psychological Horror
    Experience intense tension through retro pixel art, flickering lights, and ambient audio designed to unsettle your every step.

  • Survival-Focused Combat
    Every bullet counts. Use firearms wisely, manage stamina carefully, and master parry or stun mechanics to stay alive.

  • Scan & Survive
    Use your flashlight and a unique time pulse scanner to detect hidden objects, doors, and enemies in distorted realities.

  • Puzzle Solving Across Time
    Alter the past to change the future — but beware, some choices unlock deeper horrors.

  • Story-Rich Exploration
    Dig through time-locked rooms, encrypted terminals, and personal logs to uncover the truth about Pexet Inc. and your place in it.

What It’s Like to Play

Imagine walking into a collapsed hallway… then switching to the past to find it intact. A locked door in one timeline may be wide open in another. But the more you alter time, the more unstable your reality becomes  and something is always watching.

You’ll manage your flashlight battery, your sanity, and your timeline  because in this facility, time doesn’t heal. It hunts.

data.short_description: A top-down 2D survival horror game where you shift between timelines, solve time-based puzzles, manage limited resources, and survive deadly encounters in a collapsing research facility.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2120 / AMD A6-6400K
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 / NVIDIA GeForce 8600 GT / AMD Radeon HD 5450
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10/11
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
